messages:
maya: Ok team, I just created RC candidate 2026.03.18-rc3 (commit abcdef1). This one includes a late change: embeddings schema migration. I know late change alarm bells are up — asking for sign-off + an explicit rollback play before we promote to prod. Window: 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC. @owen @samira @sre-jen
owen: Can you paste the exact migration steps and the pinned artifact id? Need to review risk.
samira: quick smoke tests finished on staging, model latency looks fine at p95, no token regressions so far.
maya: Pinned artifact: redwood-inference:2026.03.18-rc3 (sha: abcdef1). Migration is a lightweight column-add + backfill for embeddings_index. Backfill script is idempotent but will touch ~120M rows. Backfill runs in batches.
sre-jen: That backfill size is what worries me. We need an explicit rollout + kill-switch. Suggest: 10% canary for 30m, watch queue depth & tail latency, then 50% for 20m, then full. If we see error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency spike > 500ms we roll back.
owen: Agree on staged rollout. What does rollback look like for the schema? Can we short-circuit new reads to the old index?
maya: Rollback plan: 1) flip routing to model-variant v2 (non-migration) via runtime pin (2) stop backfill (3) run migration-rollback script that marks new index inactive (no destructive delete for safety) (4) revert DB consumer flag. Full steps in the ops snippet below.
release-manager: Please add the exact commands so oncall can execute quickly. Also need release notes blurb for compliance teams.
maya: Ops commands (will add to runbook):

```
# pin traffic to previous model variant
redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --variant v2 --reason "rc3 rollback"
# stop backfill
ssh db-backfill-01 "pkill -f embeddings_backfill || true"
# mark new index inactive
psql -c "UPDATE embeddings_metadata SET active = false WHERE version = '2026.03.18-rc3'"
# clear feature flag
redwoodctl feature set embeddings_schema_migration false
```

samira: deploy-bot just reported staging CI: all checks green except one flaky eval which is unrelated.
deploy-bot: [CI] abcdef1 - all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e, canary-sim).
prod-monitor-bot: baseline alert thresholds updated for the window. Will post p95/p99 every 5m during rollout.
ownen: We should also pin the runtime kernel selection to the known-good GPU kernel (kernel v12) to avoid new perf regressions. Add that to the pre-promote checklist.
sre-jen: Add kill-switch for traffic split: redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --split 100/0 --variant v2 --now. Keep a 10m pre-seal hold before final cutover.
maya: Noted. I'll add to the promo checklist. Changelog/notes for compliance: "Embeddings index schema change: adds partitioned index to improve retrieval throughput. Backfill in batches; reversible flag-controlled activation."
release-manager: Approved from release/process side pending final sign-offs from owen and jen. Need explicit ack in thread.
ownen: Ack from eng lead: I reviewed commit abcdef1, load test snapshots look good. Approve for staged promo under the rollout above.
sre-jen: Ack from SRE: I approve the staged canary/rollback plan and will be on-call for the window.
maya: Thanks. I'll schedule the promo for 2026-03-19 02:10 UTC canary start and will post a final pre-cut message 10m before.
release-manager: Adding release notes snippet to the ticket and tagging security/compliance.
maya: Final: promoting RC now to canary. deploy-bot will post progress.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: routing change to 10% canary, artifacts pulled (redwood-inference@abcdef1). Rolling out to pool-3 nodes.
prod-monitor-bot: Canary health: p95 latency 84ms, p99 210ms, error rate 0.02% (first 5m).
samira: Observability looks clean so far, KV cache hit stable.
ownen: If metrics hold for 30m we move to 50%.
maya: Moving to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic split updated to 50%.
prod-monitor-bot: 15m into 50%: p95 90ms, p99 230ms, error rate 0.03%. No DB deadlocks.
sre-jen: All green, proceeding to full promo in 10m unless people object.
maya: Proceeding to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 100% traffic to 2026.03.18-rc3 (abcdef1).
prod-monitor-bot: Post-promo baseline: p95 92ms, p99 240ms, error rate 0.03%. Will keep 1h elevated monitoring.
release-manager: Closing the promo ticket, will attach rollout notes. Great job team. :tada:
